notes.title: 🕊️ Prepare to unveil the mysteries of Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy 🕊️
notes.content:

Get in your hydraloft in search of the mythical Great White Birds when [i]Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy[/i] lands in 2024!

[previewyoutube=lQf1kBoskWw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Set off on a quest for the Great White Birds in a mysterious land full of secrets[/h2]

Answer the call of exploration as you travel to [b]Amerzone[/b], a forgotten Latin American country, to fulfill the last wishes of a late explorer.

Investigate the ruins of this secretive land reclaimed by nature, meet intriguing characters with deep backstories and solve intricate puzzles to uncover the truth.

[h2]Will you unveil the mysteries surrounding the mythical Great White Birds?[/h2]

notes.title: Alfred Hitchcock – Vertigo : Patch Notes February 2022
notes.content:
Hello players!

today we're excited to announce that our latest patch for Alfred Hitchcock – Vertigo is out!

[h2]Art & VFX
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addition of visual effects in certain parts of the game where they weren't executed properly
[*] Changes in the lighting in certain cinematics to balance the overall quality and merge the results with conversations
[*] Overall performance improvements : Changes on the resolution of far objects to make the scenes less demanding.
[/list]

[h2]Animation[/h2]

[list]
[*] Rework of some lip-sync animations
[*] Fixing of lip-sync issues
[*] Fixing of multiple clipping issues all around the game
[*] Improvements in the vehicules animations
[*] Polish in characters animations
[*] Improvements in the conversations animations
[*] Adjustments in the cameras during conversations
[*] Hypnosis poses issues fixed.
[*] Hair Dynamics improvements, particularly on Faye.
[/list]

notes.title: Vertigo Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello dear players, 

We wish you the best year yet for 2022!

Last week a patch arrived for Alfred Hitchcock - Vertigo, here are the changes that have been made:

-	Script and subtitles fixes
-	Audio & volume balancing
-	Correction applied to the blackscreen issue, causing an infinite loading on some configurations
-	Deluxe filters are now available for the owners via an In-game option (on the Main Menu and Pause menus)
-	General animation improvements
-	General Illumination improvements
-	VFX Improvements
-	SFX Fixes
-	Voices & Lipsync Fixes
-	Multiple bug fixing

notes.title: Vertigo is now available - important information regarding Deluxe content & OST
notes.content:
Hi to all Vertigo players!

We're excited to announce that [b]Alfred Hitchcock - Vertigo[/b] has just released ːsteamhappyː!!!

[u][h3]How to get your deluxe bonuses[/h3][/u]

- Go to your Steam library
- Right click on Alfred Hitchcock - Vertigo
- Go to properties
- Select Browse local files
- From there, you should be able to access the game folders, and find a folder named [b]"Deluxe Bonus"[/b]

[u][h3]What about the soundtrack[/h3][/u]

We're sorry to announce that there'll be a little delay to get the soundtrack here, we're doing our best to make sure players who bought it will get it asap! We will update you in the next 24 hours!

Edit: the Soundtrack should be released and working fine! we're on the lookout for any problem that might be related to it.

notes.title: Story Trailer Reveal | Alfred Hitchcock – Vertigo
notes.content:
Discover the new story trailer for [b][i]Alfred Hitchcock – Vertigo[/i][/b], the game, revealing in-game footage for the first time! 


[previewyoutube=nkqqANIXFdQ;full][/previewyoutube]


This new story trailer introduces the writer Ed Miller, a car accident survivor suffering from intense vertigo. Convinced he just lost his wife and daughter in the crash, Ed starts therapy and reluctantly begins confiding in with a psychiatrist: doctor Julia Lomas. Julia will have to fight against Ed’s reluctance to dive deep into his memory and find out the hidden truth. 

Alfred Hitchcock – Vertigo is being developed by Pendulo Studios ([i]Runaway, Yesterday Origins, Blacksad: Under the Skin…[/i]) and will launch [u]December 16th 2021.[/u]

[u][b]Game features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]An [b]exclusive, original story [/b]about obsession, memory, manipulation, and madness, freely inspired by [b]Alfred Hitchcock’s masterpiece, Vertigo[/b]
[*]Live a [b]powerful narrative experience[/b] paying tribute to the visual and storytelling techniques of Hitchcock
[*][b]Investigate [/b]through the [b]vision[/b] of three characters: everyone has a different story to tell
[*][b]Explore several timelines[/b] to cross-check the events and [b]separate reality from deceptive memories[/b]
[/list]


[u][b]Digital Deluxe Edition content[/b][/u]

The Digital Deluxe Edition is available to preorder! 
Included:

On top of this, Faye and Petronius the cat avatars will be offered as pre-order bonuses.
